user.title: Configure Orcon MVS-15
user.description: Choose how the Ramses ESP gateway is connected.

mqtt_connection.title: MQTT connection
mqtt_connection.description: Enter the 15RF remote and the MQTT base topic of the gateway.

data_description.remote_id: The Ramses ID of the 15RF wireless remote, for example 29:163058.
data_description.mqtt_topic: The base topic of the Ramses ESP gateway, for example RAMSES/GATEWAY.

usb_connection.title: USB connection
usb_connection.description: Select the serial port of the Ramses ESP. Use interface 0 when the stick exposes two ports.

data_description.remote_id: The Ramses ID of the 15RF wireless remote, for example 29:163058.
data_description.usb_port: The USB serial port of the Ramses ESP, for example /dev/serial/by-id/usb-Espressif_USB_JTAG_serial_debug_unit_...-if00.

fan_discovery.title: Device Discovery
fan_discovery.description: To auto-discover your Orcon MVS-15 fan, please power cycle it after completing this setup. It will be added automatically once its startup message is received.

error.mqtt_topic_required: Enter the base MQTT topic of the gateway.
error.mqtt_topic_whitespace: The base MQTT topic cannot start or end with a space.
error.mqtt_topic_wildcard: The base MQTT topic cannot contain the wildcards + or #.
error.usb_port_required: Select the USB serial port of the gateway.
error.gateway_id_unavailable: Could not derive the gateway ID from the USB serial number. Check that the correct port is selected.

init.title: Orcon MVS-15 options
init.description: Choose which optional diagnostics the integration should enable.

data_description.packet_log: Save every received packet to packet.log in the Home Assistant configuration directory. Disable this when you are not troubleshooting; the file rolls over at 10 MB.

mqtt_setup_failed.message: Could not start the MQTT transport: {error}

session_setup_failed.message: Could not start the Ramses session: {error}

mqtt_not_available.message: The MQTT integration is not available.

usb_setup_failed.message: Could not start the USB transport: {error}

usb_not_available.message: The USB gateway is not available.

set_preset_failed.message: Failed to set fan preset mode {mode}: {error}

firmware_update_unsupported.message: Firmware updates are available over MQTT only.

firmware_update_in_progress.message: A firmware update is already in progress.

firmware_version_invalid.message: Invalid firmware version: {version}. Use a release tag such as 0.5.3.

firmware_update_failed.message: Could not start the firmware update: {error}

firmware_update_timeout.message: The gateway did not report firmware {version} after the update. Check that it is connected to WiFi and review the Home Assistant log.

reboot_during_update.message: The gateway cannot reboot while a firmware update is in progress.

fan_not_responding.title: The Orcon MVS-15 fan is not responding
fan_not_responding.description: No packet has been received from the fan {fan_id} for 30 minutes. Check that the fan has power and that the Ramses ESP gateway is within RF range, then power-cycle the fan. This issue disappears as soon as the fan is heard again.
